‘ Breaking of a vow’—A ‘vow’ consists in the taking

“As a matter of faci, the name ‘vow,’ vrata, is given

The answer to this is as follows :—It is true that in

discontinued only either if the performer had ceased to desire
the particular reward, or if the reward were actually obtained ;
in all such cases the performer would be blamed as being
energetic only in undertaking an act.
